notablePrerequisites:
Soulmender does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Soulmender.
description:
Activate Soulmender by tapping it, causing you to gain 1 life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Soulmender.
Repeat.
